mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following 2-month INDPRO sub-50 readings.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances following 0.5pp+ 3-month rises in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months when HOUST YoY growth > 10% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 60 for three consecutive months, it signals a period of strong industrial activity that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following 3-month INDPRO readings > 60.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4% while payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 per month, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and pressure corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months when UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year for two consecutive months, it signals a period of elevated inflation that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following 2-month CPI YoY growth > 3%.
